summary: Repaired recurring availability planning using timezone-aware real-minute enumeration, explicit fold selection, rule-scoped exclusions, elapsed durations, half-open busy overlap checks, full range containment, and deterministic ASCII rule ordering without input mutation.
tests_run: functions.tests: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs; 11 tests passed, 0 failed
limitations: Scoped to the contracted zones, dates in 2024–2026, minute precision, and query ranges of at most 14 elapsed days.
Uses the Node runtime Intl timezone database; no external calendar, network, or packages are used.
Enumeration includes one day of padding on either side, sufficient for the at-most-one-hour folds in the supported zones and dates; not intended as an unrestricted historical timezone resolver.
